prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1191; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left when it was struck on the driver side by a vehicle proceeding straight. Claimant reports neck strain and is seeking medical evaluation. No attorney representation noted at intake.

Entry 2: Recorded statements taken from both drivers. Insured states the oncoming vehicle entered the intersection on a late yellow signal. Other driver states the light had turned green for their direction. Independent witness contact information requested. Scene photos received and placed in file.

Entry 3: Claimant contacted the office to ask about the claims process and next steps for medical bills. Explained the adjuster's role and that claimant may seek their own medical care through their chosen provider. Claimant indicated neck pain is ongoing with limited range of motion when turning the head. No legal representation reported. Medical records request sent.

Entry 4: Police report received and reviewed. Report notes the citation issued to the vehicle proceeding straight. Liability analysis in progress, with preliminary assessment favoring the claimant's position due to the signal timing and the witness account. Vehicle damage appraisal scheduled.

Entry 5: Medical records received showing diagnosis of cervical strain with recommended physical therapy. Claimant confirmed they are continuing treatment. Claim reserve reviewed and updated to reflect the injury. Liability determination pending final review of the witness statement. Claimant has been informed of the current status and expected timeline for next contact.
